$comment: Known flakes that may fail without blocking CI. A `test` entry is matched inside a job by .github/scripts/flaky/flaky.py run. A `job` entry is matched by ci-gate: the job is rerun once, and if it fails again with `signature` in its log it is reported and does not fail the gate. Every entry needs an owner, an issue and an expiry date (at most 90 days; 7 days for a new flake). CI fails when an entry expires (ci-flaky-quarantine). See .github/workflows/FLAKY.md.
